$comment: Public profile rules, ADR 0041 (bipe/docs/adr). The server is the authority; clients check early for feedback. The name is also checked against reserved-names.json (exact match after normalize()). sealLookalikeEmoji (security.md rule 8): marks that look like the verified seal and may not appear in a display name. Compare after removing the variation selectors U+FE0E and U+FE0F from the name and the entry; an entry is found when it is a substring of the name.
